name: Apple M1 Max
memory_bandwidth_basis: vendor spec table value as printed in cited source
notes: First-gen big Apple Silicon part: up to 32-core GPU, up to 64 GB unified LPDDR5 at 400 GB/s (32-core GPU config). 24-core GPU variant has same bandwidth. Used M1 Max MacBook Pros are a budget 64GB unified-memory path.
